WoW: Forever

Protection Paladin

Shield tanking that generates threat from Holy damage rather than weapon damage, which makes it the only tank in the game that gears for Spell Power.

WoW: Forever · Tank · Updated October 16, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70374 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Protection build has been tested. Talent tiers unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. Blizzard's deep dive gives the point structure too: the one-point gold medal talents sit at 11, 21 and 31 points spent, joined in Forever by a new one at 16 points. Dual Specialization arrives at level 40.

No source has posted a level 30 build either. The cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three sites has published one since. So the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs; no guide recommends it.

This page is rewritten from Blizzard's Paladin Class Deep Dive, published October 15. Paladin was the last class in the series, so until that day every claim here came from the three guide sites or from reading the beta client. Blizzard's own caveat still stands: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

Three kinds of caveat run through these pages and they do not mean the same thing. Something marked as ours is our own reasoning rather than a source's. A client or guide-site reading is a number Blizzard has not published. The third case is the reverse: Blizzard has published it and the game does not have it. RedoubtRedoubtTalentCastInstantDuration10 secBlock chance increased by 30%. Lasts maximum of 5 blocks.'s Block figure, Iron CreedIron CreedTalentCastInstantDuration6 secIncreases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 30%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 15% for 6 sec.'s two figures and the SalvationSalvationTalentCastInstantRange30 yd rangeDuration3600 secReduces all threat generated by target party member by 30% for 3600 sec. change below are all that third case, and so are the two ReckoningReckoningTalentCastInstantGrants extra attacks after blocking. bugs Blizzard admits to.

The hover tooltips on this page come from client build 1.60.1.70374, which is the build the stamp above names: every talent and ability here has now been read against it. Where a tooltip and the prose disagree, believe the prose: it is Blizzard's figure, and the tooltip is the number the game is showing.

What Protection is for

Holding four enemies at once, and taunting without spending a talent point. Seal of FurySeal of FuryLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaDuration30 secFills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 23 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec. is learned at level 10 and judging it taunts, which Blizzard confirms is baseline rather than a talent. ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. is baseline at 20 for every Paladin, and Righteous FuryRighteous FuryLevel 10 · Spell · HolyCastInstantDuration1800 secIncreases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 90%. Lasts 1800 sec. amplifies the Holy damage both of them deal, which is why Spell Power leads your stat priority.

Four is the number to plan pulls around. Blizzard redesigned ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. so it deals moderate damage to the first 4 enemies to enter it and very low damage to everyone else. Its stated reason is parity: a Paladin should generate reliable threat on four targets at a time, the same as a Warrior's Thunderclap, because Blizzard wants Forever to keep Classic Era's combat feel instead of sliding into the AoE-focused play of later expansions. Pull four, grind them down, and expect nothing dependable from the ring past that. Mana is the other limit.

Forever nerfed the thing this spec used to be good at. Protection Paladin's dungeon levelling rested on ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec., its one source of damage to a whole pull. Forever cut dungeon experience hard, and one published guide calls that out as hurting this spec more than any other. A later beta build cut the extra experience on dungeon quests by 50%, a deliberate reduction in levelling speed.

No source publishes a levelling score for any Paladin spec. That experience cut and the guide's warning about it are what the sources say on levelling here.

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Stamina, Defense, Armor, Block, Intellect, Strength, Agility.

Spell Power first genuinely is correct here. In Forever a Paladin's threat is Holy damage: Seal of FurySeal of FuryLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaDuration30 secFills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 23 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec., ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. and Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage., all amplified by Righteous FuryRighteous FuryLevel 10 · Spell · HolyCastInstantDuration1800 secIncreases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 90%. Lasts 1800 sec.. Hit earns its second place twice over, since PrecisionPrecisionTalent · Rank 1CastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 1%. now covers spells and a resisted Judgement is a failed taunt.

Righteous FuryRighteous FuryLevel 10 · Spell · HolyCastInstantDuration1800 secIncreases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 90%. Lasts 1800 sec.'s threat bonus is deliberately smaller than Classic's, and Blizzard says why: Protection Paladins have access to more Holy damage than they did in Classic Era, so the multiplier does not need to be as high. The live figure is a 60% increase to Holy threat. Read that as a steer rather than a nerf. More of your threat now comes from the volume of Holy damage you put out yourself, which is the case for Spell Power restated.

Carry a shield and prefer a fast one-hander. The client's Seal of FurySeal of FuryLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaDuration30 secFills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 23 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec. text makes the absorb conditional on having a shield equipped. Blizzard states the seal's bonus Holy damage is a constant amount per swing, unlike Seal of RighteousnessSeal of RighteousnessSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8Cast3 sec castCost20 ManaDuration30 secTeaches Seal of Righteousness (Rank 1)., and says outright that this favours a fast weapon while tanking. Swings per second scale both your threat and your absorb. Take mail over leather where the stats are close.

Leave spell power weapons alone below 20. Wowhead flags a trap here: a weapon with a heavy spell power roll carries roughly a 25% melee damage penalty, and you do not have the spell-power talents yet to make that trade pay off. A plain melee weapon out-damages it until you hit 20.

At level 60

Unknown, and one open question is specific: whether a 4-second conditional taunt can hold a raid boss. Blizzard's closing verdict is that Paladins can be highly effective tanks, with Swift JudgementSwift JudgementTalentCastInstantCooldown60 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledFinishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%. and Templar's BulwarkTemplar's BulwarkTalentCastInstantCost110 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration8 secWhen activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active. as strong cooldowns tied to the Seal, Judgement and Forbearance systems, and baseline ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. plus Iron CreedIron CreedTalentCastInstantDuration6 secIncreases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 30%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 15% for 6 sec. giving more consistent control of the battlefield. Blizzard is equally plain about the gaps: no interrupt, no way to slow enemy movement, and limited range that Holy talents extend but never to a caster's reach. The four-target ceiling is design, not tuning, so do not expect it to lift.

The ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. bug Wowhead reported is fixed: it left targets inside the ring not taking its full damage, worst near the edge. An earlier beta build repaired Consecration's failure to apply its increased damage effect to some targets, its inconsistent Z axis, and a case where it pulled targets vertically above or below the caster.
